english.note: Use this colloquial word for a practical or personal advantage, such as getting a better deal or having circumstances in your favor.

exampleSentences.english: Buying two items now gives you an advantage.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 maai5 loeng5 gin6 jau5 zoek6 sou3

english.note: Use this colloquial noun for having an advantage over someone.

exampleSentences.english: That way, you’ll have an edge.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam3 joeng2 zou6 nei5 mai6 jau5 zoek6 sou3 lo1

english.note: Use 著數 when the advantage comes from being allowed to begin earlier.

exampleSentences.english: We leave ten minutes early, so we already have a head start.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋早十分鐘出發，已經有著數。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zou2 sap6 fan1 zung1 ceot1 faat3 ji5 ging1 jau5 zoek6 sou3
